checkerSemantics: First line n m (3<=n,m<=1000); then exactly n lines of m integers a[i][j], 0<=a[i][j]<=10^5 (public English statement shows 10<sup>5</sup>; pinned row flattened it to 105 and official test values 100000 confirm 10^5). Iahub walks (1,1)->(n,m) moving down/right, Iahubina walks (n,1)->(1,m) moving up/right; their paths share exactly one cell, which neither counts. Unique integer: maximum total of all other visited cells. The shared cell is necessarily interior (2<=i<=n-1, 2<=j<=m-1) and the paths cross it orthogonally, so answer = max over interior cells and both crossing orientations of four corner path DPs. Exhaustive enumeration of all path pairs with exactly one common cell cross-checks small grids; a flip-based second DP and reconstructed witness paths cross-check large ones. Token comparison is appropriate; no floating/multiple-answer/special checker.
